messages:
mia.lee: Heads up — noticed the latency widget on the console flipped p50/p95 ordering for /v1/embeddings this morning. looks wrong.
sam.kim: ugh, can you paste a screenshot or quick query? which org/route?
mia.lee: org=acme, route=/v1/embeddings, region=us-west-2
mia.lee: screenshot: https://redwood-internal/screens/abc123 (redaction) — p50 is higher than p95 on that endpoint in the 1h panel :eyes:
kai: that usually means mixed sample origins or bad rollup. did anyone change sampling tags or merge mode on that endpoint?
eng-platform-sig: deploy-bot: rollouts/service-config updated route-sampling to composite-merge at 2024-11-29T03:12Z
observability-bot: anomaly detected: p50(1h)=210ms, p95(1h)=180ms for /v1/embeddings (sample count: 982)
lina: quick sanity check — what does raw histogram show? p50>p95 can't be true for same distribution unless we have different cohorts or misassigned percentiles.
sam.kim: ran a raw query against the ingest store:

```
SELECT quantile(0.5) AS p50, quantile(0.95) AS p95, source_tag
FROM latency_samples
WHERE route='/v1/embeddings' AND org='acme' AND ts > now()-1h
GROUP BY source_tag
```

sam.kim: results:
- source_tag=route-serving: p50=180, p95=300
- source_tag=proxy-cache: p50=220, p95=190
- source_tag=canary-variant: p50=240, p95=400

mia.lee: aha — proxy-cache tag shows p50>p95 (220 > 190)
kai: That proxy-cache row is obviously noisy. I bet we have sample weights inverted in the composite rollup for that source_tag.
lina: can we check the sampler metadata for proxy-cache? maybe count normalization bug.
eng-platform-sig: sam.kim assigned @kai to investigate sampling weight codepath
kai: quick grep of rollup merge code shows we use reservoir sample + weight sign from incoming envelope. Found spot where weight default was -1 for cached hits when header absent. oops.
sam.kim: if weight negative, that could reorder tdigest updates and produce skewed quantiles on merge.
mia.lee: timeline: bug introduced in rollout 7 days ago which toggled composite-merge on these routes. explains why we didn't see before.
kai: patch idea: treat missing weight as +1, and clamp negative weights. will open PR.
observability-bot: post-commit: PR #4123 opened by kai — "fix/sampler-default-weight-clamp"; test run scheduled.
lina: also UX note — can we show source_tag breakdown in the widget by default when percentiles invert? makes triage faster.
eng-platform-sig: agreed, filing console ticket to add a small "cohort breakdown" toggle on percentile cards.
sam.kim: temporary mitigation: add a telemetry alert that fires when p50>p95 for any single route so oncall gets paged.
mia.lee: thanks team. i'll keep monitoring acme route and will revert composite-merge on their config if we still see inversion after the fix.
kai: PR + unit tests coming in ~1h. once merged we should re-ingest a small window and verify quantiles converge.
mia.lee: :thumbsup: thanks!
